verification_report.summary: Sequential verification of Sections 1–8 found no critical errors or gaps. The square/product decompositions give controlled differences of positive currents, making the energy continuity argument valid. Separate-variable subsheaf closure establishes energy positivity and the exponential identities for the full CPsh sheaf without assuming a common smooth approximation sequence. The mixed-energy Schwarz inequality, integration-by-parts signs, compact C^2 coefficient passage, and endpoint factor b_n=1 are correct. The coefficient comparison and exponential cancellation yield exactly the stated constant C(k,a), including the zero-norm case. Applying the estimate with each smooth polar truncation fixed, then using monotone convergence, proves local integrability; positive-form domination extends it to total variations of arbitrary smooth traces. The rational-domain construction supplies the required compact positive sublevels over trivially valued fields as well, while the constant branch handles simultaneous numerator zeros. Prime avoidance, canonical integrability of log|f|, and its explicit decreasing smooth psh truncations establish the analytic-subset consequence. The theorem-search endpoint was unavailable; the cited definitions and hypotheses were checked directly through the web fallback in the [CLD manuscript](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1204.6277v2). The proof does not import the source's local-approchability restriction on all factors or rely on its defective endpoint calculation and barrier wording.
